repos.name: Recipen
repos.why: Held out, batch 3 (M5B.5). Vite React SPA (client/, JSX) and a CommonJS Express + Mongoose server (server/) side by side, no root package.json. Every API request is an RTK Query endpoint (builder.query/builder.mutation in four feature apiSlice.injectEndpoints modules, query returning a path string or { url, method }); the API slice's baseQuery is a custom baseQueryWithReauth that hands each endpoint's args to fetchBaseQuery({ baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_SERVER_BASE_URL }) (no in-code fallback) and itself calls baseQuery("/auth/refresh") after a 403. Routers are mounted at /api/auth, /api/user, /api/recipe, /api/blog, /api/stripe with router.route(path).<method>(…) chains. One axios upload goes to Cloudinary on an env-only URL. ~97 JS source files.

repos.name: strafes-site
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b1, drawn in stratum react-express). Yarn workspace: a Vite React + TypeScript client, an Express server, and a shared types package. Every client API request goes through client/src/api/api.ts, where tryGetRequest(path, params) / tryPostRequest(path, body) hand a bare path ("user/rank/" + id) to tryRequest's fetch("/api/" + url) on the page's own origin (Vite's server.proxy sends /api to the server's port 8080 in dev; the same Express app serves client/build in production). All ~25 routes are app.get/app.post calls with full /api/... paths in server/src/index.ts, no routers or mounts, ending in a *splat SPA fallback. The server calls Roblox APIs through axios helpers (some memoized) and the StrafesNET APIs through two committed, generated swagger-typescript-api clients; the client also fetches its bundled .wasm and signed replay URLs returned by the API, and commits wasm-bindgen glue with fetch calls. ~104 TS/JS source files incl. generated code.

repos.name: checkmvp
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b4, drawn in stratum nextjs-prisma). A single Next.js App Router app (src/app) with Prisma, Redis rate limiting, and OpenAI, whose route.ts handlers under src/app/api export one method each ([id] segments, literal pdf/ and social_media_campaigns/ folders beside [id]). Client components call them with root-relative fetch (literals and one-id templates, one bare GET with no options). Two server-side client classes (src/common/client/{Concept,Idea}/Service.ts) fetch paths fixed in their methods on `${this.baseURL}`, constructed elsewhere with env.CONCEPT_SERVICE_API_BASE / env.IDEA_SERVICE_API_BASE (zod-required, no in-code fallback; .env.example and .env.test set both to http://localhost:3000/api, the app's own port), so the app calls its own routes over HTTP. Traps: the Concept client is imported under the alias IdeaService; the clients' unit tests stub global.fetch; a route test hands a new Request(...) straight to a handler; GET /api/limits has no caller. Not labeled: the OpenAI SDK, Sentry, Plausible, and ioredis. ~328 TS/JS source files incl. ~45 tests.

repos.name: twitter-clone
repos.why: Held out, batch 2 (M5A.4a2). Single-package Next.js pages router app with Prisma: client components and hooks call its own pages/api handlers by root-relative path. Most reads are SWR keys (useSWR(`/api/posts/${postId}`, fetcher)) handed to one libs/fetcher.ts that calls axios.get(url), so the URL is written at the useSWR call while the request expression is in the fetcher, which no repo code calls; writes are inline axios calls (one URL chosen by a ternary held in a const), plus one fetch. Handlers pick their methods with req.method guards (405, a switch, an open handler that only rejects GET). ~85 TS source files.

repos.name: Tic-Tac-Toe-Fullstack-Game
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b1, drawn in stratum react-express). A Vite React + TypeScript SPA (frontend/) and a JS Express + Mongoose backend (backend/), no workspace. Most screens call one axios.create({ baseURL: API_URL }) instance (frontend/src/utils/api.ts), API_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_API_BASE || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE || "https://tic-tac-toe-backend-api.vercel.app" (vite.config.ts defines process.env.REACT_APP_API_BASE with the same fallback; frontend/.env.example sets that host). The game board calls fetch(apiUrl(path)) through a local `${API_BASE}${path}` builder and the navbar inlines the same base; some axios calls are chains split across lines (api, then .get(…) on the next line). That host is labeled as the repo's backend because backend/vercel.json routes every path to it (ADR-0209). backend/app.js mounts five routers at /auth, /profile, /leaderboard, /social, /realtime (no /api prefix) with router.get/post/put calls. The board also opens a WebSocket (not labeled). ~45 TS/JS source files.

repos.name: WealthWise-Finance-Tracker
repos.why: npm-workspaces Turborepo: a Next.js 14 app router web app calling a separate Express API (apps/api, routers mounted under /api/v1) through a fetch wrapper in lib/api-client.ts that takes the path as a parameter, so call sites are the wrapper's callers in TanStack Query hooks. Also has Express-based mcp/agentic-ai packages. ~308 source files.

repos.name: foodie
repos.why: Create React App SPA (frontend/) and an Express server (server/) side by side with no workspace config. Requests go through httpRequest(), a wrapper over axios(config) with axios.defaults.baseURL built from REACT_APP_ env vars and an /api/v1 prefix. ~167 source files.

repos.name: instagram-mern
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b1, drawn in stratum react-express). A Create React App frontend (React 17, Redux + redux-thunk) whose thunk action creators (frontend/src/actions/*.js) and three components call plain imported axios on root-relative /api/v1/... template URLs, no instance or baseURL; CRA's package.json proxy (http://localhost:4000) reaches the API in dev, and the same Express app serves frontend/build in production. backend/app.js (started by the root server.js) mounts four routers, each created with express() rather than express.Router(), at the same /api/v1 prefix; each declares router.route(path).<method>(…) chains. S3 and SendGrid are reached only through SDKs, and chat runs over socket.io. Commits its CRA build output under frontend/build (out of scope). ~80 TS/JS source files without the build.

repos.name: tesior-web
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b3, drawn in stratum nextjs-prisma). A yarn + Turborepo monorepo whose one Next.js 14 App Router app (apps/next-web) serves the app and admin hostnames, its middleware rewriting pages by Host header (the matcher skips /api). The client calls its route.ts handlers in two ways: direct root-relative fetch templates with query strings (`/api/task/${taskId}?workspaceId=…` as PUT; a literal workspaces/repo/exists folder beside [idOrSlug]) and SWR hooks (useSWR, useSWRImmutable, swr imported as useSwr) passing the repo's own fetcher, some on conditional keys (`slug && …`). Two requests go to external hosts (GitHub's REST API through SWR, CoinGecko), and the edge middleware fetches its own /api/database/admin on an env host that must be bare (it's compared with the Host header), so that URL has no scheme and reaches nothing. Two Cloudflare Hono workers (apps/indexer, apps/tesior-bot) sit beside it; nothing calls them and they send no fetch (Octokit and Prisma only). Solana RPC goes through web3.js. ~198 TS/JS source files.

repos.name: wanderlust
repos.why: Vite React frontend and Express backend (routers mounted at /api/posts, /api/auth, /api/user). Most calls use an axios.create() instance whose baseURL is assigned afterwards via instance.defaults.baseURL from VITE_API_PATH; the rest call axios directly with that env var concatenated. ~109 source files.

repos.name: online-ide
repos.why: Held out (M5A.2b). Vite React frontend (frontend/) and an ESM Express + Prisma backend (backend/) side by side, no root package.json. Every request is an inline axios call (or one streaming fetch) on `${process.env.SERVER_URL}/...`, where process.env.SERVER_URL is substituted by vite.config.js `define` from REACT_APP_SERVER_URL, with no in-code fallback; template ternaries pick between two routes, and a router is mounted at a parameterized path (/editorial/:problemStatementId, mergeParams). The backend calls GitHub's OAuth and user APIs. ~80 JS source files.

repos.name: snagtime
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b3, drawn in stratum nextjs-prisma). A Next.js App Router app (apps/web) with Prisma, served by route.ts handlers under src/app/api (`export async function GET/POST/…`, [id] and [slug] segments, a literal bookings/manage-link folder beside bookings/[id]). Every browser request goes through one request(path, init) wrapper around fetch in src/lib/api-client.ts, called with a root-relative /api/... path in each one-line method of a snagTimeApi object (default GET, query strings, a ternary only in the query); components/api-adapter.ts re-exports the methods without supplying paths, and one component fetches a path constant from that object. Playwright e2e tests send plain fetch calls and an untracedJson(path) helper to NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, which playwright.config.ts sets to the app its webServer starts (page.request is the runner's own client, not labeled), and scripts/load-check.mts fetches `new URL("/api/…", LOAD_BASE_URL)`, a CI secret with no value in the repo whose server must report the commit's build ID. Google, Stripe, and email are reached only through SDKs. ~200 TS/JS source files incl. tests and scripts.

repos.name: nextjs-prisma-boilerplate
repos.why: Held out, batch 2 (M5A.4a3). Single-package Next.js pages router app with Prisma, served by a custom Express server (server/index.ts: express.static for /uploads, then server.all('*') handing every request to Next). API routes are next-connect handlers (handler.get(…), handler.post(…), 405 for other methods). Every client request is in a react-query hook calling one axios.create() instance without baseURL, with paths from a Routes.API constants object (`${Routes.API.POSTS}${id}`, Routes.API.PROFILE beside the dynamic /api/users/[id]); one helper takes a whole image URL. Tests use supertest and msw (not fetch/axios, not labeled). ~200 TS/JS source files incl. tests.

repos.name: trendz
repos.why: Held out, batch 3 (M5B.6). Vite React + TypeScript client (client/) and a TypeScript Express + Supabase server (server/, `$/` path alias) side by side; the root package.json only runs Prettier. Almost every request is an inline call on one axios.create({ baseURL: `${config.serverUrl}/api`, withCredentials }) instance, mostly inside TanStack Query queryFn/mutationFn arrows and named queryFn functions (useQuery, useInfiniteQuery, useMutation), some paths without a leading slash (`likes/${id}`) or with a query string; config.serverUrl is a ternary between two env vars on import.meta.env.MODE, no in-code fallback. Login, register, and logout call plain axios.post on `${config.serverUrl}/api/auth/...` held in a const. Routers are mounted at /api/* in server/src/main.ts with router.<method>(path, authMiddleware, handler). The server calls an image-moderation API through axios.request(config) on an env URL. Tests use supertest (not labeled). ~190 TS source files incl. tests.

repos.name: conversa
repos.why: Vite React frontend whose single API module builds every fetch URL as `${API_BASE}/...` with API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ?? a localhost fallback; the CommonJS Express backend mounts routers via app.use(path, require(...)). No root package.json. ~112 source files.

repos.name: accountill
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b1, drawn in stratum react-express). A Create React App SPA (React, Redux) beside an ESM Express + Mongoose server, no workspace. Most requests are one-line wrappers in client/src/api/index.js on one axios.create({ baseURL: process.env.REACT_APP_API }) instance (no in-code fallback; the README sets http://localhost:5000, the server's PORT fallback), with literal or template paths and query strings, and an interceptor that only adds a header; three components call plain axios on `${process.env.REACT_APP_API}/…`. server/index.js mounts four routers at /invoices, /clients, /users, /profiles (flat router.<method>() calls) and registers /send-pdf, /create-pdf, /fetch-pdf on app. Route order matters (a literal /count before /:id, /profiles/search caught by /:id), and one client request (GET /clients/:id) has no route. A fetch uploads to Cloudinary. Commits its CRA build output under client/build (out of scope). ~75 TS/JS source files without the build.

repos.name: mern-starter-cli
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b2, drawn in stratum react-express). A scaffolding CLI (bin/cli.js, which sends no requests of its own) whose templates/ hold a Vite React client and a TS Express server, with no per-template package.json. The client calls one axios instance (templates/client/src/lib/axios.js, baseURL `${VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:5000'}/api/v1`, the fallback matching env.example.txt and the server's PORT default 5000) through an authAPI object of one-line wrappers, plus a refreshSession() helper with its path fixed inside it; a 401 interceptor re-sends the failed request with api(request), which isn't a call site. The server mounts appRouter at /api/v1 and authRouter under it at /auth (one registration spans several lines); the admin routes are never called. Server tests use supertest and email goes through the Resend SDK (neither labeled). ~67 TS/JS source files.

repos.name: devcamper
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b2, drawn in stratum react-express). A CRA React client (src/webapp) whose services each do `const uri = await fetchApiEndPoint(path); fetch(uri, …)`: the helper only joins the path to a base read at runtime from the committed public/config/config.json (development http://localhost:5000/api/v1, the Express server's PORT fallback; production http://devcamper.webapi/api/v1, which the repo's k8s ingress routes to the webapi service), so the URL is fixed in each service function. A JS Express API (src/webapi) mounts six routers under /api/v1 with router.route(path) chains split across lines, and nests the courses and reviews routers under /bootcamps/:bootcampId (mergeParams) while also mounting them directly. Four client requests match no route (POST /courses/bootcamps/:id/, GET on the POST-only /user/logout, /user/getMe vs the server's /me, /user/resetpassword without its token), and the config.json fetch is a static file. ~67 TS/JS source files.

repos.name: notx
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b4, drawn in stratum nextjs-prisma). A single Next.js pages-router app (Prisma, JWT in localStorage, Mantine UI): every request is a plain fetch written inline in a page component (pages/allNotes.tsx, createNote.tsx, login.tsx, signup.tsx) on a literal same-origin path, the method in the options object; no wrapper, SWR, or axios. Routes are pages/api/** default-export handlers. Traps: signup.tsx writes its URL without a leading slash ("api/auth/signup"), which the browser resolves against the page's own URL (/signup, no basePath or trailingSlash, so /api/auth/signup); most handlers run only under `if (req.method === "X")` and answer any other method with a 500 (labeled by method), while fetchNote.ts and deleteNote.ts check no method (ALL), so a POST to one and a DELETE to the other reach ALL routes. Not labeled: Link and Router.push navigations; pages/api/hello.ts and fetchAllNotes.ts have no callers. 20 TS/JS source files, the size floor.

repos.name: next-crud
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b4, drawn in stratum nextjs-prisma). A library (src/, a Prisma-backed CRUD handler for Next.js) with a pages-router example app in example/. The example's pages call their own API with root-relative fetch (/api/users, `/api/users/${id}`, a ?page= query inside a react-query useInfiniteQuery, /api/users/custom), and getServerSideProps fetches `${process.env.API_URL}/users/${id}` with no in-code fallback (the committed example/.env sets http://localhost:3000/api, Next's default dev port). A committed, generated swagger-typescript-api client (example/Api.ts, never instantiated) calls this.request({ path, method }) in ten endpoint methods on a default http://localhost:3000/api base. Routes: one pages/api/[...nextcrud].ts catch-all whose handler hands every method to the library (ALL /api/*nextcrud), a literal pages/api/users/custom.ts that Next serves ahead of the catch-all and that runs code only for GET, and an App Router app/api/appdir/[...nextcrud]/route.ts that nothing calls. Traps: literal before catch-all, the request helper inside the generated client, an env base set only in a committed .env, and the library's handler code, which sends no requests. Not labeled: swagger-ui-react's own fetch of /api/docs; the library's tests call handlers directly through node-mocks-http. ~53 TS/JS source files incl. tests and the docs site.

repos.name: mern-ecommerce
repos.why: Held out (M5A.2c). Create React App frontend (frontend/) and a CommonJS Express + Mongoose backend (backend/) side by side, no root package.json. Every request goes through one axios.create({ withCredentials, baseURL: process.env.REACT_APP_BASE_URL }) instance imported by per-feature features/*/…Api.jsx modules (axiosi.get(`/cart/user/${id}`)), with no in-code fallback; the auth module's paths have no leading slash ("auth/login"). Routers are mounted at /auth, /users, /products, … and chain router.post(...).get(...) calls. ~123 JS source files.

repos.name: taxonomy
repos.why: Single-package Next.js 13 app router app: client components fetch its own route handlers (app/api/posts, app/api/posts/[postId], app/api/users/[userId], app/api/users/stripe) by root-relative path, plus one call to an external host (api.github.com) and two fetches of bundled font files via new URL(…, import.meta.url). Widely used reference app. ~131 source files.

repos.name: mern-social
repos.why: Held out (M5A.2c). One package: a webpack React client (client/) server-rendered by an Express + Mongoose server (server/), Babel ES modules. Per-feature client/*/api-*.js modules call fetch with root-relative, concatenated paths ('/api/users/' + params.userId) on the same origin; the server mounts three routers at '/', each declaring full paths in router.route(path).get(…).put(…) chains, plus a catch-all app.get('*') for server-side rendering. Default branch second-edition. ~43 JS source files.

repos.name: v0.diy
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b4, drawn in stratum nextjs-prisma). A Next.js App Router app (Drizzle on Postgres, NextAuth) in one package whose browser code calls its own src/app/api/**/route.ts handlers (mostly `export const X = handleRoute(...)`) through one wrapper, requestJson(url, init) in src/lib/http-client.ts, from per-feature lib/*-api.ts modules, with URLs from a chatUrls object of path builders (`${chatPath(id)}/files`, chatPath URI-encoding the id); two fetch(chatUrls.resume(id))-style calls are direct. Traps: a global SWRConfig fetcher (requestJson) behind a useSWR(key) with no fetcher of its own, on a conditional key; useSWR calls whose fetcher ignores its key (one key isn't a URL), so the helper's request is the call site; `/api/chats/import/${kind}` over a three-member literal union, each member passed by a caller (three labels, ADR-0041); a literal import/ folder beside [chatId]; server-side calls to v0's API through a requestV1(apiKey, path) wrapper on the literal https://api.v0.dev/v1 (null). Not labeled: the chat stream, sent by @v0-sdk/react's V0Transport with useChat; v0 SDK client calls; SWR mutate revalidations; a server-action login and NextAuth calls; a download link. ~197 TS/JS source files.

repos.name: IceLink
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b2, drawn in stratum react-express). A Create React App + TypeScript SPA (frontend/) beside a TS Express + Mongoose backend (backend/), no workspace. Every request goes through one axios.create({ baseURL: process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL || "http://localhost:5000/api" }) instance (frontend/src/api/axiosInstance.ts; frontend/.env.example sets the same value, the server's PORT fallback is 5000), whose interceptor only adds a bearer header, called from one-line wrappers in frontend/src/api/{auth,chat,message}.api.ts and directly from AuthContext with literal or template paths relative to the /api base. backend/src/index.ts applies a rate limiter at /api/, then mounts three routers at /api/users, /api/chats, /api/messages (flat router.<method>() calls); a fourth, call.routes.ts, is never mounted and never called. Chat and WebRTC signaling run over socket.io (not labeled); Google auth and Cloudinary are SDKs. ~72 TS/JS source files.

repos.name: Shopify-Nextjs-Prisma-app
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b3, drawn in stratum nextjs-prisma). A pages-router Shopify embedded app in plain JS (Next.js + Prisma) whose debug pages send root-relative fetch requests to its own pages/api handlers, each exported as withMiddleware("verifyRequest")(handler). Three are direct fetch calls; three go through a hook in the same file, useDataFetcher(initial, url, options), so the path and the method (a const options object with method: "POST") come from each caller. Some handlers branch on req.method and answer 400 to the rest (labeled by method), others run for every method (ALL). App Bridge adds auth headers to plain fetch, and all traffic to Shopify's Admin and Partners APIs goes through Shopify's libraries (not labeled). ~42 JS source files.

repos.name: community-resource-board
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b2, drawn in stratum react-express). A CRA client sends every request through one axios instance (frontend/src/services/api.jsx) whose baseURL is normalizeBaseUrl(REACT_APP_API_URL || (NODE_ENV === 'production' ? an onrender.com host : 'http://localhost:5000')); the helper trims trailing slashes and strips a trailing /api, so the base is the host root (localhost:5000 in development, matching .env.example and the server's PORT fallback) and every path carries its full /api/... prefix. About 20 apiHelpers methods fix their paths inside the helper module, while pages and the auth context call api.get/post/put/patch/delete inline on template paths. backend/src/server.js mounts four JS routers with app.use('/api/<name>', require(...)) after /api rate limiters and registers GET /health on app. Traps: two route files are never mounted, an uploadFile(endpoint) helper has no callers, the applications router uses regex-constrained params ('/:id([0-9a-fA-F]{24})'), literal routes (/my, /admin/all, /featured) are registered before /:id, and several components build /uploads image URLs from the same env var without requesting them. ~50 TS/JS source files.

repos.name: airbnb-clone
repos.why: Held out, batch 4 (M5C.5b3, drawn in stratum nextjs-prisma). A single-package Next.js 16 App Router app with Prisma whose client components send every request with plain imported axios.post/axios.delete on root-relative URLs (literals for creates, templates with one id for deletes and favorites), most written as `axios` with `.post(…)` on the next line, to six route.ts handlers exporting named POST/DELETE functions under [listingId]/[reservationId] folders; one hook picks POST or DELETE on the same path by branch. Reads are server-side Prisma calls in app/actions, auth is NextAuth's pages-router catch-all (called only by the library), and uploads go through a Cloudinary widget. Vitest tests mock axios and send nothing. ~100 TS/JS source files incl. tests.

heldOutBatches.seen: Their false positives and negatives were read during M5A.3g–3i, though no fix was chosen from them (ADR-0168).
Its misses were diagnosed and fixed in M5B.1–M5B.2c (next-connect methods, SWR fetchers, negated req.method tests), each fix written from the library's contract and its own fixture (ADR-0168).

Its misses were diagnosed in eval/results/2026-11-batch3-diagnosis.md and fixed in M5C.2 (RTK Query base queries that forward to fetchBaseQuery), written from RTK's documented re-authorization example and its own fixture (ADR-0201).

Its misses were diagnosed in eval/results/2026-11-batch4-diagnosis.md, and M5C.7's fixes were chosen from them (#18 option 2), each written from a library's or the language's contract with its own fixture, starting with M5C.7a (a method through a rest element; an unread method between routes of different methods is unresolved, ADR-0033).
